## How to test

## Checklist

- [ ] `go build ./...`, `go vet ./...`, `gofmt -l .` and `go test ./...` pass
- [ ] `go run ./cmd/conformance lint` passes if `docs/contract/` changed
- [ ] Behavior on the wire matches the contract (or the contract/decision log is updated)
- [ ] Comments, identifiers, docs and commit messages are in English
- [ ] No personal or infrastructure data (hostnames, IPs, local paths, real library names)
- [ ] No AI co-author trailer or "generated with" footer in commits
- [ ] I updated docs / CHANGELOG if the change is user-visible
